description: The composed PROOF OF WORK for a work order's reconciliation (WO-F02, Documenso #1917537): the cold map, the hot audit's findings, and a verdict per clause, folded into one contract and written as a sealed output — the engine stamps its content_sha and input_shas, so the contract is content-addressed by construction, never by an agent's own hashing. This is what the sovereign settles against and what a DEFAULT cites: the document that makes 'the work was done' a checkable claim instead of a recollection.

cold_map_ref.description: content_sha (or output id) of the sealed reconciliation-map this contract composes from.

audit_verdict_ref.description: content_sha (or output id) of the sealed hot-audit change-verdict this contract composes from.

clause_verdicts.description: One verdict per clause of the order — the cold map's row joined with the audit's finding for that clause. Copies only: the composer draws no verdict of its own.

audit_finding.description: The audit's verdict for this clause, verbatim: upheld, refuted (with the refutation), or unaudited (with why — e.g. budget exhausted, receipt absent).

evidence_refs.description: The citations the finding rests on — output ids, file paths, URLs probed, check names run.

proposed_state.description: What the composed evidence supports — a PROPOSAL only. The adjudicator rules on default; only the sovereign, settling at the human seat, records 'satisfied'.
